instruction: Love is not a spiritual practice. Love itself is the highest state of divine absorption. Faith and devotion are steps on the path. But love is a much higher state only the fortunate can reach. In this love, the lover and the Divine become one. There is no feeling of 'two' or even 'one'. The thinking mind stops completely. This state of total stillness is called 'Samadhi'.
